notes: Public key is small-order encoding 6 of the canonical set: the crafted signature satisfies the cofactorless equation only because k is a multiple of 8. With the small-order check removed a verifier reaches the next subgroup check (E_SIG_MIXED_ORDER_A) for the six points of order 8; with both subgroup checks removed the record would be valid (spec §3.3, §3.4).
